paragraphs: Dynatrace combines broad and deep observability, continuous runtime application security, and advanced agentic AI operations to deliver answers and intelligent automation across IT operations, development, security, business, and executive teams. This unified approach enables organizations to optimize their rapidly evolving AI, cloud, and IT operations, accelerate secure software delivery, and improve digital performance. Our vision is a world where software works perfectly.

The Dynatrace platform is built to scale, partnering and integrating seamlessly into hybrid, multicloud ecosystems, including major hyperscalers such as Amazon Web Services ("AWS"), Microsoft Azure ("Azure"), and Google Cloud Platform ("GCP"), as well as traditional on-premises and mainframe solutions.

Our customers include many of the world's largest enterprises which deploy the Dynatrace platform to support increasingly complex IT environments. As workloads scale and cybersecurity threats evolve, cloud modernization and rapid AI adoption have significantly increased data volume and complexity, rendering traditional monitoring and observability approaches insufficient for many organizations. We believe this positions Dynatrace to address a significant market opportunity through our differentiated platform, deep cloud ecosystem integrations, and trusted customer and partner relationships.

Dynatrace offers a fully integrated platform that brings together differentiated data, context, and intelligence layers. The Dynatrace platform's architecture is built for the scale and complexity of modern cloud and AI-driven observability and operations. We believe the Dynatrace platform is different from other offerings through three connected capabilities:

•Dynatrace has a unified data foundation. We store and consolidate all observability, security, and business data types, including logs, traces, metrics, real user data, events, sessions, and other telemetry, in an integrated, highly performant and massively scalable data lakehouse called GrailTM, without the need for upfront indexing, schema design, or data movement. Through Grail's single authoritative data layer, we enable AI to work from a comprehensive set of continuously updated information, which we believe makes insights and actions faster, more reliable, and more scalable than fragmented toolchains and multiple data stores.

•The Dynatrace platform provides near real-time causal context. Dynatrace stores unified data in context, and our proprietary Smartscape® technology is able to analyze billions of interdependencies across applications, infrastructure, networks, services, users, and other signals throughout an enterprise. Smartscape continuously maps these relationships, creating a living, near real time dependency graph. This allows an organization using Dynatrace to understand not just what is happening, but why it is happening and the resulting business and operational impact, providing a trusted foundation needed for AI-driven decisions, reliable automation, and autonomous operations.

•The Dynatrace platform utilizes AI-driven reasoning and automation. Earlier this year, we announced the general availability of Dynatrace Intelligence, a new agentic operations system built for modern software ecosystems that combines deterministic AI with agentic AI. Dynatrace Intelligence empowers organizations to build more resilient applications, elevate customer experiences, and drive autonomous action across modern digital ecosystems. With Dynatrace Intelligence at its core, we believe our platform is purpose-built for the agentic era, enabling a future where AI-powered observability can help customers automatically prevent, remediate, and optimize their IT environments. We believe our experience in AI gives our customers a competitive advantage in developing their own AI initiatives. We are continuing to invest in AI best practices in services, data, and observability to support our customers on their AI journeys and to enable AI practices of our partners.
The Dynatrace platform comprises several solutions, including the following:

•AI Observability (LLM and Agentic AI Observability) provides observability to improve the performance, resilience, explainability, and compliance of generative AI applications, large language models ("LLMs"), and agentic systems - including agent-to-agent interactions and actions taken by agents to better monitor and manage these workloads.

•Log Management and Analytics provides a unified approach to unlock the value of log data in the Dynatrace platform and can be developed for different use cases with enterprise-grade extensibility and customization.

•Modern Cloud Observability natively integrates with cloud and container environments to transform our customers' cloud operations with complete visibility and proactive monitoring across their entire cloud infrastructure in one platform.

•Infrastructure Observability provides complete visibility into a customer's IT infrastructure layer across public and private clouds and hybrid, multicloud environments, including AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, VMware Tanzu, Red Hat OpenShift, and Kubernetes.

•Application Observability monitors the full stack (i.e., front-end and back-end technologies) through application performance monitoring ("APM"), distributed tracing, and profiling across public and private clouds and hybrid, multicloud environments.
•Digital Experience allows customers to monitor user experiences across channels with real-user and synthetic monitoring and session replays and encompasses mobile and web applications.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry
We have experienced rapid revenue growth in recent periods, which may not be indicative of our future growth.
Overall demand and market adoption of the solutions that we offer may not grow as we expect, which may harm our business and prospects.
The markets in which we operate are highly competitive, which may adversely affect our ability to add new customers, retain existing customers, and grow our business.

If we fail to innovate and do not continue to develop and effectively market solutions that anticipate and respond to the needs of our customers, our business, operating results, and financial condition may suffer.
If we are unable to acquire new customers or retain and expand our relationships with existing customers, our future revenues and operating results will be harmed.

Failure to effectively expand our sales and marketing capabilities could harm our ability to execute on our business plan, increase our customer base, and achieve broader market acceptance of our applications.

If our platform and solutions do not effectively interoperate with our customers' existing or future IT infrastructures, installations of our solutions could be delayed or canceled, which would harm our business.
If the prices we charge for our solutions and services are unacceptable to our customers, our operating results will be harmed.
We believe the Dynatrace brand is integral to our future success and if we fail to cost-effectively maintain and enhance awareness of our company, our business and competitive position may be harmed.
Our sales cycles can be long, unpredictable and vary seasonally, which can cause significant variation in the number and size of transactions that close in a particular quarter.
Our quarterly and annual operating results may be adversely affected due to a variety of factors, which could make our future results difficult to predict.

We rely on highly skilled personnel and if we are unable to attract, retain, or motivate substantial numbers of qualified personnel or expand and train our personnel, we may not be able to grow effectively.
Any failure to offer high-quality customer support and professional services may adversely affect our relationships with our customers and our financial results.

We believe that our corporate culture has contributed to our success, and if we cannot successfully maintain our culture as we grow, we could lose the innovation, creativity, and teamwork fostered by our culture.
Our sales to government entities are subject to a number of challenges and risks.
Risks Related to AI, IT, IP, and Data Security and Privacy
Security breaches, computer malware, computer hacking attacks, and other security incidents or compromises could harm our business, reputation, brand, and operating results.
paragraphs: Investing in our common stock involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all of the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including the section titled "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" and our consolidated financial statements and related notes, before making a decision to invest in our common stock. The risks and uncertainties described below may not be the only ones we face. If any of the risks actually occur, our business, operating results, financial condition and prospects could be materially and adversely affected. In that event, the market price of our common stock could decline, and you could lose all or part of your investment.

We have experienced rapid revenue growth in recent periods. Our annual revenue grew 19%, 19%, and 23% in the years ended March 31, 2026, 2025, and 2024, respectively, compared to the prior year. This revenue growth may not be indicative of our future revenue growth, and we may not be able to sustain revenue growth consistent with recent history, or at all. We believe our ability to continue to increase our revenue depends on several factors, including, but not limited to:
•our ability to attract new customers and retain and increase sales to existing customers;
•our ability to continue to expand customer adoption and usage of our Dynatrace platform;

•our ability to develop our existing platform, introduce new solutions, enhance and improve existing solutions on our platform, and keep pace with technological developments (including rapid advances in AI and other emerging technologies);
•continued growth of cloud-based services and solutions;

paragraphs: The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and related notes appearing elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. The following discussion and analysis contains forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties. When reviewing the discussion below, you should keep in mind the substantial risks and uncertainties that could impact our business. In particular, we encourage you to review the risks and uncertainties described in the section titled "Risk Factors" under Part I, Item 1A in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. These risks and uncertainties could cause actual results to differ materially from those projected in forward-looking statements contained in this report or implied by past results and trends. Our fiscal year ends on March 31. Our historical results are not necessarily indicative of the results that may be expected for any period in the future.

Dynatrace combines broad and deep observability, continuous runtime application security, and advanced agentic AI operations to deliver answers and intelligence automation across IT operations, development, security, business, and executive teams. This unified approach enables organizations to optimize their rapidly evolving AI, cloud, and IT operations, accelerate secure software delivery, and improve digital performance. Our vision is a world where software works perfectly.

Our customers include many of the world's largest enterprises which deploy the Dynatrace platform to support increasingly complex IT environments. As workloads scale and cybersecurity threats evolve, cloud modernization and rapid AI adoption have significantly increased data volume and complexity, rendering traditional monitoring or observability approaches insufficient for many organizations. We believe this positions Dynatrace to address a significant market opportunity through our differentiated platform, deep cloud ecosystem integrations, and trusted customer and partner relationships.

We take Dynatrace to market through a combination of our global direct sales team and a network of partners, including GSIs, cloud providers, resellers and technology alliance partners. Dynatrace addresses customer needs at various scales and sizes, but our global direct sales team targets the largest 15,000 companies globally.

We generate revenue primarily by selling subscriptions, which we define as SaaS agreements, term-based licenses, and maintenance and support agreements. The majority of our customers deploy Dynatrace as a SaaS solution to get the latest Dynatrace features and updates with greatly reduced administrative effort. We also provide options to deploy our platform in customer-provisioned infrastructure.

Our DPS licensing model provides customers with a flexible, scalable, and transparent subscription for the modern cloud. Under the DPS licensing model, a customer makes a minimum annual spend commitment at the platform level and then consumes that commitment based on actual usage and a straightforward rate card. Any platform capability can be used in any quantity at any time based on the customer's evolving needs.
The Dynatrace platform has been commercially available since 2016 and is the primary offering we sell.
Our financial highlights for the year ended March 31, 2026 were:
•Our annual recurring revenue ("ARR") was $2,054 million as of March 31, 2026, which reflected 18% growth year-over-year;
•Our total revenue was $2,018 million, which reflected 19% growth year-over-year; •Our subscription revenue was $1,930 million, which reflected 19% growth year-over-year;
•We delivered GAAP income from operations of $245 million and non-GAAP income from operations(1) of $592 million; and
•Our net cash provided by operating activities and free cash flow(1) was $562 million and $529 million, respectively.

(1) Non-GAAP financial measure. For additional information, please see the "Key Metrics" section below for applicable definitions and the "Non-GAAP Financial Results" section below for a reconciliation to the most directly comparable GAAP financial measure.

We believe in a disciplined and balanced approach to operating our business. We plan to continue driving innovation to meet customers' needs and grow our customer relationships. We also plan to invest in future growth opportunities that we expect will drive long-term value, while leveraging our global partner ecosystem, optimizing costs, and improving efficiency and profitability.
Dynatrace 結合廣泛且深入的可觀察性、持續的執行時應用程式安全性和先進的代理型 AI 操作，以提供跨 IT 操作、開發、安全、業務與高階管理團隊的解答與智能自動化。這種統一的方法使組織能夠優化其快速演進的 AI、雲端與 IT 操作，加速安全軟體交付，並提升數位表現。我們的願景是軟體能完美運作。
Dynatrace 平台建構於可擴展的基礎上，能與混合雲端生態系統順暢合作與整合，包括主要的超大型雲端服務供應商如 Amazon Web Services ("AWS"), Microsoft Azure ("Azure"), 以及 Google Cloud Platform ("GCP"), 以及其他傳統的內部部署與大型主機解決方案。
我們的客戶包括許多全球最大的企業，這些企業部署 Dynatrace 平台以支援日益複雜的 IT 環境。隨著工作負載擴張與網路安全威脅演進，雲端現代化與快速 AI 採用已顯著增加資料量與複雜度，使傳統的監控與可觀察性方法對許多組織而言已顯不足。我們相信這使 Dynatrace 能透過我們差異化的平台、深入的雲端生態系統整合以及受信賴的客戶與夥伴關係，來應對重要的市場機會。
Dynatrace 提供一個完全整合的平台，將差異化的資料、情境與智慧層次結合在一起。Dynatrace 平台的架構建構於現代雲端與 AI 驅動的可觀察性與操作的規模與複雜性之上。我們相信 Dynatrace 平台透過以下三個相互關聯的能力，與其他產品不同：

•Dynatrace 具備統一的資料基礎。我們儲存並整合所有可觀察性、安全性和業務資料類型，包括日誌、追蹤、指標、真實用戶資料、事件、會話及其他 telemetry 資料，於一個整合、高性能且可大規模擴展的資料湖屋 GrailTM 中，無需事先建立索引、資料庫設計或資料移動。透過 Grail 的單一權威資料層，我們使 AI 能從持續更新的完整資訊集進行運作，我們相信這使洞察與行動比分散的工具鏈與多個資料儲存更快速、更可靠且更可擴展。

•Dynatrace 平台提供近乎即時的因果情境。Dynatrace 在情境中儲存統一資料，我們專利的 Smartscape® 技術能分析應用程式、基礎設施、網路、服務、用戶及其他訊號之間的十億級關聯性。Smartscape 會持續地繪製這些關聯，建立一個活躍的、近乎即時的依賴圖。這使使用 Dynatrace 的組織不僅能瞭解發生了什麼，還能瞭解發生的原因以及產生的業務與運作影響，為 AI 驅動的決策、可靠的自動化與自主運作提供可信的基礎。

•Dynatrace 平台運用 AI 驅動的推理與自動化。今年初，我們宣佈 Dynatrace Intelligence 一般可用，這是一個為現代軟體生態系統設計的新代理型操作系統，結合確定性 AI 與代理型 AI。Dynatrace Intelligence 賦予組織建立更強韌應用程式、提升用戶體驗，並在現代數位生態系統中驅動自主行動的能力。以 Dynatrace Intelligence 為核心，我們相信我們的平台是為代理型時代設計的，使未來 AI 驅動的可觀察性能協助客戶自動預防、修復與優化其 IT 環境。我們相信我們在 AI 方面的經驗，使客戶在發展自己的 AI 計畫時擁有競爭優勢。我們持續投資於 AI 最佳實務，以支援客戶在 AI 旅程上的發展，並使我們的夥伴能實踐 AI 方面的實務。
Dynatrace 平台包含多種解決方案，包括以下內容：
•AI Observability (LLM and Agentic AI Observability) 提供可觀察性以提升生成式 AI 應用程式、大型語言模型 ("LLMs") 和代理系統的性能、韌性、可解釋性與合規性，包括代理間互動及代理執行的動作，以更好地監控與管理這些工作負載。
•Log Management and Analytics 提供一種統一的方法，以在 Dynatrace 平台中釋放日誌資料的價值，並可針對不同使用案例進行開發，具企業等級的擴展性與客製化能力。
•Modern Cloud Observability 原生整合雲端與容器環境，以一個平台轉變客戶的雲端作業，提供完整的可視性與主動監控，涵蓋其整個雲端基礎設施。
•Infrastructure Observability 提供完整的可視性，讓客戶在其公有雲、私有雲與混合、多雲環境中的 IT 基礎設施層進行監控，包括 AWS、Azure、Google Cloud、VMware Tanzu、Red Hat OpenShift 和 Kubernetes。
•Application Observability 透過應用程式效能監控 ("APM")、分散式追蹤與剖析，監控完整的應用程式堆疊（即前端與後端技術），涵蓋公有雲、私有雲與混合、多雲環境。
•Digital Experience 讓客戶能透過實際用戶與合成監控及會話重播，監控用戶在各通路的體驗，並涵蓋行動與網頁應用程式。

paragraphs: 以下對我們財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析，應與本年度10-K表報中其他處所出現的合併財務報表及相關附註一併閱讀。以下討論與分析包含風險與不確定性之向前看聲明。在審閱以下討論時，您應留意可能影響我們業務的大量風險與不確定性。特別地，我們鼓勵您審閱本年度10-K表報第一部分第1A項標題為「風險因素」之節中所描述的風險與不確定性。這些風險與不確定性可能導致實際結果與本報告中向前看聲明所預測或根據過去結果與趨勢所暗示者有重大差異。我們的會計年度於3月31日結束。我們的歷史結果未必能代表未來任何期間的結果。
Dynatrace結合廣泛且深入的可觀察性、持續的執行時應用程式安全、以及先進的代理AI運作，以提供跨IT運作、開發、安全、業務與高階管理團隊的解答與智慧自動化。這種統一的方法使組織能夠優化其快速演變的AI、雲端與IT運作，加速安全軟體交付，並改善數位表現。我們的願景是軟體能完美運作。
我們的客戶包括許多全球最大企業，這些企業部署Dynatrace平台以支援日益複雜的IT環境。隨著工作負載擴張與網路安全威脅演變，雲端現代化與快速AI採用已顯著增加資料量與複雜性，使許多組織傳統監測或可觀察性方法變得不足。我們相信這使Dynatrace能透過我們差異化的平台、深入的雲端生態系整合，以及受信賴的客戶與夥伴關係，來面對一個重要的市場機會。
我們透過全球直接銷售團隊與一個包含GSIs、雲端供應商、經銷商與科技合作夥伴的網路來推廣Dynatrace。Dynat、race針對不同規模與大小的客戶需求提供解決方案，但我們的全球直接銷售團隊則針對全球最大的15,000家公司。
我們主要透過銷售訂閱服務來產生收入，我們定義訂閱服務為SaaS協議、基於期限的授權與維護與支援協議。我們的大多數客戶將Dynatrace作為SaaS解決方案部署，以取得最新的Dynatrace功能與更新，並大幅減少行政工作。我們也提供選項，讓客戶在其自備基礎設施中部署我們的平台。
我們的DPS授權模式為客戶提供一個靈活、可擴展且透明的現代雲端訂閱方案。根據DPS授權模式，客戶在平台層面做出最低年度支出承諾，然後根據實際使用情況與簡潔的費用明細來消耗該承諾。根據客戶的演變需求，任何平台功能都可以在任何時間以任何數量使用。
Dynatrace平台自2016年起已商業化，是我們主要銷售的產品。
我們2026年3月31日財務重點為：
•本公司年度經常性營收（"ARR"）於2026年3月31日為20.54億美元，反映與去年同期相比成長18%；
•本公司總營業收入為20.18億美元，反映與去年同期相比成長19%；•本公司訂閱營收為19.30億美元，反映與去年同期相比成長19%；
•我們實現了根據一般會計準則（GAAP）的營業利益為 245 百萬美元，以及根據非一般會計準則（non-GAAP）的營業利益（1）為 592 百萬美元；且
•我們的營運活動所產生的淨現金流入及自由現金流（1）分別為 562 百萬美元及 529 百萬美元。
(1) 非GAAP財務指標。如需更多資訊，請參閱下方"關鍵指標"部分中適用之定義，以及"非GAAP財務結果"部分中與最直接可比之GAAP財務指標之調整說明。
本公司相信應以嚴謹且平衡的方式經營業務。我們計畫持續推動創新以符合客戶需求並拓展客戶關係。我們也計畫投資未來成長機會，預期這些機會將驅動長期價值，同時善用全球夥伴生態系統、優化成本、並提升效率與獲利能力。

headings: 與我們業務及產業相關之風險
我們在近期經歷快速的營業收入成長，此情形可能無法反映我們未來的成長情形。
我們所提供的解決方案之總體需求與市場採用率可能無法如我們預期般成長，這可能會對我們的業務與前景造成損害。
我們所從事之市場具有高度競爭性，這可能會對我們增加新客戶、維持現有客戶及成長業務的能力產生不利影響。
若我們未能創新，並持續開發及有效行銷能預見並回應客戶需求之解決方案，則我們的業務、營運結果與財務狀況可能會受到損害。
若我們無法取得新客戶或維持並擴大與現有客戶之關係，我們未來之營收與營運結果將受到損害。
若我們未能有效拓展銷售與行銷能力，可能會對我們執行業務計畫、擴大客戶羣及實現應用程序之廣泛市場接受度的能力造成損害。
若我們之平台與解決方案無法有效與客戶之現有或未來資訊科技基礎建設 interoperability，則我們之解決方案安裝可能會延遲或取消，這將對我們之業務造成損害。
若我們對解決方案及服務所訂定的價格無法被客戶接受，將會對我們的營運成果造成損害。
我們認為 Dynatrace 品牌對我們未來的成功至關重要，若我們無法以成本效益的方式維持並提升本公司知名度，將可能對我們的業務及競爭地位造成損害。
我們的銷售週期可能長、難以預測且具有季節性變動，這可能會導致特定季度內交易筆數及交易規模產生顯著變動。
我們的季度及年度營運成果可能因多種因素而受到不利影響，這可能會使我們未來的成果難以預測。
我們依賴高素質的員工，若我們無法吸引、留住或激勵足夠數量的合格人才，或擴充並培訓我們的員工，我們可能無法有效成長。
若無法提供高品質的客戶支援及專業服務，可能會對我們與客戶的關係及財務成果造成不利影響。
我們認為本公司文化已為我們的成功做出貢獻，若我們在成長過程中無法成功維持此文化，可能會失去我們文化所培養的創新、創造力及團隊合作精神。
我們對政府機構的銷售面臨許多挑戰與風險。
與人工智慧、資訊科技、智慧財產權及資料安全與隱私權相關之風險
